posed_to_both_builds: parcel 100,100 (no scene, so no PBSkyboxTime can take the clock), dynamic graphics OFF, graphics profile High, Dynamic Skybox OFF, Custom Skybox = Midday
result: the pinned sky is real in 1.x and absent in 2.x

1x.note: the selection is applied live and does not survive a relaunch (it reverts to the stored value), so the three windows belong to one session started once

2x.settings_persisted: Dynamic Skybox off, Custom Skybox = Midday, dynamic graphics off, profile High (all four read back from the panel after a relaunch)
2x.cause: lib/crates/dcl_engine/src/sky/skybox_time.rs reads setting("skybox_time") with .try_to::<f64>().unwrap_or(0.0); the fallback is 0.0 = midnight, so a value that does not arrive as a number renders midnight while the shell shows the chosen preset
2x.note: no window was measured on 2.x for this scenario because the condition could not be established; publishing one would be comparing a midnight render against a midday render
